tc_name: Complete purchase using saved address and card (Happy Path)
description: Verify a user can search for a product, add to cart, checkout using saved address and credit card, and receive an order confirmation.
precondition: User is logged in, has a valid saved delivery address and a saved payment method, stable internet connection.

steps.step_desc: Launch Amazon app on Samsung SM-A226B
steps.expected: App opens to home screen

steps.step_desc: Tap on search field and enter a valid product name (e.g., 'wireless headphones')
steps.expected: Search suggestions appear; search results displayed

steps.step_desc: Select a product from results
steps.expected: Product detail page (PDP) opens with price, availability and Buy/Add to Cart options

steps.step_desc: Tap 'Add to Cart'
steps.expected: Item added to cart; mini cart updated

steps.step_desc: Proceed to cart and tap 'Proceed to Buy' or 'Checkout'
steps.expected: Checkout page displays delivery address and payment options

steps.step_desc: Confirm saved address and select saved credit card as payment
steps.expected: Selected address and payment are populated

steps.step_desc: Place order
steps.expected: Order is processed and order confirmation page with order id is displayed; confirmation email/push notification received

tc_name: Search using voice/keyboard and use 'Use my current location' for delivery
description: Verify user can search for product and select 'Use my current location' to autofill delivery pin/address during checkout.
precondition: Location permission granted to the app; internet connection available.

steps.step_desc: Open app and enter product keyword in search field (//android.widget.EditText[@resource-id='in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping:id/rs_search_src_text'])
steps.expected: Search results displayed

steps.step_desc: Select a product and proceed to checkout
steps.expected: Checkout page loads

steps.step_desc: Tap 'Use my current location' (//android.widget.Button[@resource-id='in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping:id/loc_ux_gps_auto_detect'])
steps.expected: App retrieves current GPS location and autofills delivery pincode/address

steps.step_desc: Confirm delivery address and place order
steps.expected: Order placed successfully using the detected address

tc_name: Login flow via webview with valid credentials and OTP
description: Verify login via Amazon webview (apwebview) using email and OTP completes and returns user to checkout flow.
precondition: User has an active Amazon account and mobile number for OTP; internet connectivity.

steps.step_desc: From checkout, select login and ensure webview (apwebview) opens
steps.expected: Webview loads login page (//android.webkit.WebView[@resource-id='in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping:id/apwebview'])

steps.step_desc: Enter registered email/phone in ap_email_login field (//android.widget.EditText[@resource-id='ap_email_login'])
steps.expected: Email/phone accepted

steps.step_desc: Request OTP and enter received OTP
steps.expected: OTP accepted and user logged in

steps.step_desc: Continue checkout after login
steps.expected: User returns to checkout with saved/available addresses

tc_name: Resend OTP when OTP not received
description: Verify 'Resend OTP' link works and prevents brute force attempts by rate limiting or displaying cooldown.
precondition: User initiated login and OTP delivery is delayed or failed; webview displayed.

steps.step_desc: On OTP entry screen in webview, do not receive OTP within expected time
steps.expected: No OTP received

steps.step_desc: Tap 'Resend OTP' (//android.view.View[@resource-id='cvf-resend-link'])
steps.expected: OTP resent and UI shows confirmation or countdown

steps.step_desc: Attempt rapid repeated taps on 'Resend OTP'
steps.expected: App enforces cooldown or displays error to prevent abuse

description: Verify app handles payment failures gracefully and provides actionable error messages when card is declined.
precondition: User logged in with a payment method that will be declined (expired/insufficient funds).

steps.step_desc: Add product to cart and proceed to checkout
steps.expected: Checkout page displayed

steps.step_desc: Select the expired/declined card as payment and attempt to place order
steps.expected: Payment gateway rejects transaction and error message shown

steps.step_desc: Verify user can select alternative payment or retry
steps.expected: User offered options to update card, try another method or save order for later

tc_name: Search yields no results - user sees helpful suggestions
description: Verify when search term returns no results, app shows helpful suggestions like spelling corrections, broader categories, or popular items.

steps.step_desc: Enter a gibberish or very specific unavailable product into search field
steps.expected: No results page displayed

steps.step_desc: Observe UI for suggestions such as spelling corrections, 'Try these instead' or category suggestions
steps.expected: Helpful suggestions displayed and user can navigate to suggested items

tc_name: Out of stock item selected at checkout
description: Verify behavior when an item becomes out of stock between adding to cart and checkout.
precondition: User adds item to cart. Inventory changes to out-of-stock before checkout.

steps.step_desc: Add item to cart
steps.expected: Item added to cart

steps.step_desc: Proceed to checkout after delay (simulate inventory change)
steps.expected: Checkout flow detects item is out of stock and shows message

steps.step_desc: Ensure user cannot place order for out-of-stock item and is offered options (remove item, waitlist, similar items)
steps.expected: Appropriate fallback options presented

tc_name: Cancel during checkout and verify cart persistence
description: Verify that canceling checkout or tapping back keeps the cart intact and returns user to previous screen.
precondition: User has items in cart and is on checkout page.

steps.step_desc: From checkout, tap 'Cancel' (//android.widget.Button[@resource-id='in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping:id/top_bar_cancel_text_button'])
steps.expected: Checkout cancelled and user returned to cart or previous page

steps.step_desc: Re-open cart
steps.expected: Previously added items remain in cart with correct quantities and prices

tc_name: Close promotional modal/pop-up and continue purchase
description: Verify that closing modal/pop-up (e.g., promotional offers) does not disrupt checkout flow or cause navigation issues.
precondition: A promotional modal appears during browsing or checkout.

steps.step_desc: When promotional modal appears, tap 'Close' (//android.widget.Button[@resource-id='closeButton'])
steps.expected: Modal closes and underlying screen is visible

steps.step_desc: Continue the purchase flow (navigate to product or checkout)
steps.expected: User can continue without loss of state or errors

description: Verify app behavior and resilience during slow or temporarily lost network while performing search and checkout.
precondition: Simulate network throttling or intermittent connectivity on device.

steps.step_desc: Start search for a product under network throttling
steps.expected: App shows loading state; results eventually load or timeout with message

steps.step_desc: Attempt to add item to cart and proceed to checkout with intermittent connectivity
steps.expected: App queues/saves actions where possible; shows retry options on failure; no duplicate orders placed when connection restored

steps.step_desc: Restore stable connection and retry any failed steps
steps.expected: User can complete checkout or is informed of partial failures

tc_name: Attempt login with invalid email and navigate Back
description: Verify entering invalid email on apwebview shows validation and that back navigation returns to previous state without crashes.

steps.step_desc: Enter invalid email format into ap_email_login field (//android.widget.EditText[@resource-id='ap_email_login']) and submit
steps.expected: Inline validation error displayed preventing submission

steps.step_desc: Tap device/app back button (//android.widget.ImageButton[@resource-id='in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping:id/chrome_action_bar_back_icon']) to return to previous screen
steps.expected: App navigates back gracefully and session remains stable

tc_name: Place order with maximum allowed quantity and apply coupon
description: Verify behavior when user selects the maximum allowed quantity for a product and applies a coupon/promo code during checkout.
precondition: Product allows multiple quantities; a valid coupon code available; user logged in.

steps.step_desc: On product page, set quantity to maximum permitted value
steps.expected: Quantity updates and subtotal recalculates

steps.step_desc: Add to cart and proceed to checkout
steps.expected: Checkout shows correct total with quantity reflected

steps.step_desc: Apply valid coupon code and verify discount applied
steps.expected: Coupon accepted; discount reflected in order total

steps.step_desc: Place order and confirm order placement
steps.expected: Order placed successfully; confirmation shows correct discounted total and quantities
